title: EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen says the EU will take action against "addictive design" on TikTok and Instagram, including "endless scrolling" (Sawdah Bhaimiya/CNBC)
summary: Sawdah Bhaimiya / CNBC: EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen says the EU will take action against “addictive design” on TikTok and Instagram, including “endless scrolling” — The EU is clamping down on social media firms and plans to target “addictive design” features on TikTok …
contentText:
Sawdah Bhaimiya / CNBC :

EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen says the EU will take action against “addictive design” on TikTok and Instagram, including “endless scrolling”   —  The EU is clamping down on social media firms and plans to target “addictive design” features on TikTok …
